description: Inclusion does not prove execution. Only a record bound to the retained hash, nonce, block, sender, recipient and OS amount with status confirmed succeeds; a bound failed record is a permanent failure; anything else stays indeterminate without a second broadcast.

fixtureVocabulary.statusIndex: node status-index label for the retained hash; never decisive
fixtureVocabulary.inclusionObservation: block identified for the retained hash, or null
fixtureVocabulary.recordRead: transaction-record read: found, not-found or unavailable
fixtureVocabulary.guards: checks whose removal makes this vector fail

vectors.name: included-confirmed
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record is the only success; evidence and delivery follow.

vectors.name: included-failed
vectors.note: Included is not executed: a bound failed record is a durable permanent failure with no replacement.

vectors.name: included-pending
vectors.note: Included with a pending record is unresolved and authorizes nothing.

vectors.name: included-record-not-found
vectors.note: Included but no record for the retained hash: execution is unknown and nothing is resent.

vectors.name: included-record-unavailable
vectors.note: An unreachable node leaves execution unknown; no success, failure or delivery.

vectors.name: included-alias
vectors.note: A record status copied from the index label is not an execution result.

vectors.name: finalized-alias
vectors.note: Finality vocabulary is not the executed record status.

vectors.name: success-alias
vectors.note: Only the exact Demos record status confirmed establishes execution.

vectors.name: confirmed-case-variant
vectors.note: Status comparison is exact; a case variant is unknown.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-hash
vectors.note: A confirmed record for another hash says nothing about the retained transfer.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-nonce
vectors.note: A record whose nonce differs from the signed nonce is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-block
vectors.note: A record in a different block from the inclusion observation is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-sender
vectors.note: A record debiting another sender is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-recipient
vectors.note: A record paying another recipient is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-amount
vectors.note: A record for a different OS amount is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-missing-nonce
vectors.note: A record missing its nonce is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-float-nonce
vectors.note: Binding compares exact JSON types: 9.0 is not the signed integer nonce 9.

vectors.name: confirmed-boolean-nonce
vectors.note: Binding compares exact JSON types: true is not the signed nonce 1.

vectors.name: confirmed-without-inclusion-observation
vectors.note: Without an inclusion observation the record's block cannot be bound.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-nonce
vectors.note: A failed record with another nonce does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-missing-nonce
vectors.note: A failed record missing its nonce does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-block
vectors.note: A failed record in another block conflicts with the inclusion observation.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-amount
vectors.note: A failed record for another amount does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-hash
vectors.note: A failed record for another hash does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-without-inclusion-observation
vectors.note: A failed record without an inclusion observation is not a bound failure.

vectors.name: transfer-unknown-not-rebroadcast
vectors.note: Neither index nor record knows the hash; the handler still only re-reads.

vectors.name: resume-reuses-failure-proof
vectors.note: A resume after a proven failure reuses it even while the node is unreachable.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof
vectors.note: A retained proof whose nonce no longer binds is not reused; re-read only.

vectors.name: resume-without-proof-not-found
vectors.note: A crash after a possible broadcast resumes by re-reading, never resending.

vectors.name: resume-without-proof-confirmed
vectors.note: Re-reading the retained hash finds the executed transfer; no second payment.

vectors.name: first-broadcast-after-durable-retention
vectors.note: The single broadcast is allowed once all five values are durably retained.

vectors.name: broadcast-before-durable-retention
vectors.note: Volatile retention cannot support recovery, so the broadcast is refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-incomplete-retention
vectors.note: A retained transfer without its signed nonce is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: second-broadcast-refused
vectors.note: The same signed bytes are not sent again once they may have been broadcast.

vectors.name: replacement-broadcast-refused
vectors.note: A replacement transfer is never sent for the same job phase.

vectors.name: consumer-confirmed-admitted
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record satisfies DEM-7; other checks still apply.

vectors.name: consumer-included-only-refused
vectors.note: An included label without a record is not admitted as payment.

vectors.name: consumer-pending-refused
vectors.note: A pending record is not admitted as payment.

vectors.name: consumer-unavailable-refused
vectors.note: An unreachable node supplies no execution result.

vectors.name: consumer-finalized-alias-refused
vectors.note: Only the exact confirmed status is admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-failed-fails
vectors.note: A bound failed record refutes the success evidence.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payee-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read that pays another payee does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-block-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read in another block does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payer-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read from another payer does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-amount-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record for another amount is fail.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payee-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record paying another payee is fail.
